sets.subject: Quant
sets.passage_en: The table shows the number of units sold by two stores, A and B, over four years. Study it and answer the questions that follow.
sets.passage_hi: तालिका में चार वर्षों में दो दुकानों A और B द्वारा बेची गई इकाइयों की संख्या दी गई है। इसे पढ़कर आगे के प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।

chart_data.title_en: Units sold by two stores (in hundreds)
chart_data.title_hi: दो दुकानों द्वारा बेची गई इकाइयाँ (सैकड़ों में)

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice data set written for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I pattern (Statistical Charts, Data Interpretation). Synthetic values; not an SSC data set.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: What is the unit digit of 7^2026?
questions.text_hi: 7^2026 का इकाई अंक क्या है?
questions.solution_en: The unit digit of powers of 7 repeats every 4: 7, 9, 3, 1. Since 2026 mod 4 = 2, the unit digit is the same as 7^2 = 49, i.e. 9.
questions.solution_hi: 7 की घातों का इकाई अंक हर 4 पर दोहराता है: 7, 9, 3, 1। 2026 को 4 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 2 है, इसलिए इकाई अंक 7^2 = 49 के समान, अर्थात 9 होगा।
questions.trick_en: For unit digits, divide the exponent by 4 and use the remainder only: remainder 2 means second entry in 7, 9, 3, 1.
questions.trick_hi: इकाई अंक के लिए घात को 4 से भाग दें और केवल शेषफल देखें: शेषफल 2 का अर्थ 7, 9, 3, 1 में दूसरा अंक।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Number Systems for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ. Unit-digit cycle verified by computation.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: What is the smallest positive integer by which 2520 must be multiplied so that the product becomes a perfect square?
questions.text_hi: वह सबसे छोटी धनात्मक पूर्णांक संख्या क्या है जिससे 2520 को गुणा करने पर गुणनफल एक पूर्ण वर्ग बन जाए?
questions.solution_en: 2520 = 2^3 × 3^2 × 5 × 7. In a perfect square every prime exponent is even. The odd exponents are 2^3, 5^1 and 7^1, so we must multiply by 2 × 5 × 7 = 70. Then 2520 × 70 = 176400 = 420^2.
questions.trick_en: Prime-factorise, then multiply all primes whose exponent is odd. Do not multiply by a square factor.
questions.trick_hi: अभाज्य गुणनखंड करें और जिन अभाज्यों की घात विषम है, उन्हें गुणा करें। किसी वर्ग गुणक से गुणा न करें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Number Systems for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ. Factorisation and square root rechecked numerically.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: A number is first increased by 20% and then the increased number is decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
questions.text_hi: किसी संख्या को पहले 20% बढ़ाया जाता है और फिर बढ़ी हुई संख्या को 20% घटाया जाता है। शुद्ध परिवर्तन क्या है?
questions.solution_en: Take the number as 100. After a 20% increase it becomes 120. A 20% decrease on 120 gives 120 × 0.80 = 96. The net change is 96 − 100 = −4, i.e. a 4% decrease.
questions.trick_en: For +20% then −20%, use the single factor 1.20 × 0.80 = 0.96, which is a 4% decrease.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Percentages for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ. Successive-change factor checked numerically.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: If A : B = 3 : 4 and B : C = 8 : 9, then A : C is:
questions.text_hi: यदि A : B = 3 : 4 और B : C = 8 : 9 है, तो A : C क्या है?
questions.solution_en: Make B common. A : B = 3 : 4 = 6 : 8 and B : C = 8 : 9, so A : B : C = 6 : 8 : 9. Hence A : C = 6 : 9 = 2 : 3.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Ratio and proportion for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: The average of 11 numbers is 36. The average of the first 6 numbers is 34 and the average of the last 6 numbers is 38. What is the 6th number?
questions.text_hi: 11 संख्याओं का औसत 36 है। पहली 6 संख्याओं का औसत 34 और अंतिम 6 संख्याओं का औसत 38 है। छठी संख्या क्या है?
questions.solution_en: Sum of all 11 numbers = 11 × 36 = 396. Sum of the first 6 = 6 × 34 = 204. Sum of the last 6 = 6 × 38 = 228. Adding the first six and last six counts the 6th number twice: 204 + 228 = 432. Therefore the 6th number = 432 − 396 = 36.
questions.trick_en: The overlap element = (sum of first group + sum of last group) − total sum.
questions.trick_hi: उभयनिष्ठ संख्या = (पहले समूह का योग + अंतिम समूह का योग) − कुल योग।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Averages for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ. Recomputed from group sums.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: An article costing ₹400 is marked 25% above the cost price and then sold after a 10% discount on the marked price. What is the profit percentage?
questions.text_hi: ₹400 में खरीदी गई वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य लागत मूल्य से 25% अधिक रखा जाता है और फिर अंकित मूल्य पर 10% छूट देकर बेचा जाता है। लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है?
questions.solution_en: Marked price = 400 × 1.25 = ₹500. Selling price = 500 × 0.90 = ₹450. Profit = 450 − 400 = ₹50. Profit percentage = 50/400 × 100 = 12.5%.
questions.trick_en: Effective factor = 1.25 × 0.90 = 1.125, so profit is 12.5% of cost.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Profit and loss for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: What is the compound interest on ₹8,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually?
questions.text_hi: ₹8,000 पर 10% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्ष का चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज क्या होगा, जब ब्याज वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है?
questions.solution_en: Amount = 8000 × (1.10)^2 = 8000 × 1.21 = ₹9,680. Compound interest = 9,680 − 8,000 = ₹1,680. (Simple interest for 2 years would be ₹1,600.)

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Compound interest for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: A and B together can complete a piece of work in 12 days. A alone can complete it in 20 days. In how many days can B alone complete the work?
questions.text_hi: A और B मिलकर एक काम 12 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। A अकेला उसे 20 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। B अकेला वह काम कितने दिनों में पूरा करेगा?
questions.solution_en: Combined work per day = 1/12. A's work per day = 1/20. B's work per day = 1/12 − 1/20 = (5 − 3)/60 = 2/60 = 1/30. So B alone takes 30 days.
questions.trick_en: B's time = (A × combined)/(A − combined) = (20 × 12)/(20 − 12) = 30.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Time and work for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: A 150 m long train crosses a pole in 9 seconds. How long will it take to cross a 300 m long platform?
questions.text_hi: 150 मीटर लंबी एक ट्रेन एक खंभे को 9 सेकंड में पार करती है। 300 मीटर लंबे प्लेटफॉर्म को पार करने में उसे कितना समय लगेगा?
questions.solution_en: Speed = 150/9 = 50/3 m/s. To cross a platform the train covers its own length plus the platform: 150 + 300 = 450 m. Time = 450 ÷ (50/3) = 450 × 3/50 = 27 seconds.
questions.trick_en: Platform time = pole time × (train + platform)/(train) = 9 × 450/150 = 27 s.
questions.trick_hi: प्लेटफॉर्म का समय = खंभे का समय × (ट्रेन + प्लेटफॉर्म)/(ट्रेन) = 9 × 450/150 = 27 सेकंड।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Time and distance for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: A 60-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 7 : 3. If 20 litres of the mixture is removed and replaced with 20 litres of water, what is the new ratio of milk to water?
questions.text_hi: 60 लीटर के मिश्रण में दूध और पानी का अनुपात 7 : 3 है। यदि 20 लीटर मिश्रण निकालकर उसके स्थान पर 20 लीटर पानी डाला जाए, तो दूध और पानी का नया अनुपात क्या होगा?
questions.solution_en: Initially milk = 60 × 7/10 = 42 L and water = 18 L. Removing 20 L removes 14 L milk and 6 L water, leaving 28 L milk and 12 L water. Adding 20 L water gives 28 L milk and 32 L water, i.e. 28 : 32 = 7 : 8.
questions.solution_hi: शुरू में दूध = 60 × 7/10 = 42 ली और पानी = 18 ली। 20 ली निकालने पर 14 ली दूध और 6 ली पानी निकलता है, शेष 28 ली दूध और 12 ली पानी। 20 ली पानी मिलाने पर 28 ली दूध और 32 ली पानी, अर्थात 28 : 32 = 7 : 8।
questions.trick_en: After removing one-third of the mixture, two-thirds of each component remains: milk 42 × 2/3 = 28. Then add all 20 L to water.
questions.trick_hi: मिश्रण का एक-तिहाई निकालने पर प्रत्येक घटक का दो-तिहाई बचता है: दूध 42 × 2/3 = 28। फिर पूरे 20 ली पानी में मिलाएँ।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Mixture and alligation for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ. Recomputed component-wise.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: A invests ₹40,000 for 12 months and B invests ₹60,000 for 10 months in a business. If the total profit is ₹18,000, what is A's share?
questions.text_hi: A किसी व्यवसाय में ₹40,000 का निवेश 12 महीनों के लिए और B ₹60,000 का निवेश 10 महीनों के लिए करता है। यदि कुल लाभ ₹18,000 है, तो A का हिस्सा क्या है?
questions.solution_en: Profit shares are proportional to capital × time. A : B = (40,000 × 12) : (60,000 × 10) = 4,80,000 : 6,00,000 = 4 : 5. A's share = 18,000 × 4/9 = ₹8,000.
questions.trick_en: Reduce capital-time products before applying the total: 480 : 600 = 4 : 5, then 4 parts of 9.
questions.trick_hi: कुल लागू करने से पहले पूँजी-समय गुणनफल को छोटा करें: 480 : 600 = 4 : 5, फिर 9 में से 4 भाग।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Partnership business for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: The marked price of an item is ₹750. It is sold at two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. What is the selling price?
questions.text_hi: किसी वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य ₹750 है। उसे 20% और 10% की दो क्रमिक छूटों पर बेचा जाता है। विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?
questions.solution_en: After 20% discount: 750 × 0.80 = ₹600. After a further 10% discount: 600 × 0.90 = ₹540. (Adding the discounts to 30% would wrongly give ₹525.)
questions.trick_en: Successive discounts multiply: 0.80 × 0.90 = 0.72, so selling price = 72% of marked price.
questions.trick_hi: क्रमिक छूटें गुणा होती हैं: 0.80 × 0.90 = 0.72, अतः विक्रय मूल्य अंकित मूल्य का 72% है।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on Discount for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: If x + 1/x = 5, then x^2 + 1/x^2 equals:
questions.solution_en: Square both sides: (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 2 + 1/x^2 = 25. Therefore x^2 + 1/x^2 = 25 − 2 = 23.
questions.trick_en: Use the identity (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2. Subtract 2 from the square.
questions.trick_hi: सर्वसमिका (x + 1/x)^2 = x^2 + 1/x^2 + 2 का उपयोग करें। वर्ग में से 2 घटाएँ।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on School algebra identities for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: If a + b + c = 0 and abc ≠ 0, then a^2/(bc) + b^2/(ca) + c^2/(ab) equals:
questions.text_hi: यदि a + b + c = 0 और abc ≠ 0 है, तो a^2/(bc) + b^2/(ca) + c^2/(ab) का मान क्या है?
questions.solution_en: When a + b + c = 0, the identity a^3 + b^3 + c^3 = 3abc holds. Divide both sides by abc (valid because abc ≠ 0): a^2/(bc) + b^2/(ca) + c^2/(ab) = 3.
questions.solution_hi: जब a + b + c = 0 हो, तो सर्वसमिका a^3 + b^3 + c^3 = 3abc लागू होती है। abc ≠ 0 होने के कारण दोनों पक्षों को abc से भाग दें: a^2/(bc) + b^2/(ca) + c^2/(ab) = 3।
questions.trick_en: Multiply the expression by abc to get (a^3 + b^3 + c^3)/(abc) = 3abc/abc = 3.
questions.trick_hi: व्यंजक को abc से गुणा करें: (a^3 + b^3 + c^3)/(abc) = 3abc/abc = 3।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on algebraic identities for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ. Verified by substitution (a=1, b=2, c=-3).

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: What is the measure of each interior angle of a regular hexagon?
questions.text_hi: एक समषट्भुज के प्रत्येक अंतःकोण का माप क्या है?
questions.solution_en: A hexagon has 6 sides. Sum of interior angles = (6 − 2) × 180° = 720°. In a regular hexagon all angles are equal, so each angle = 720°/6 = 120°.
questions.solution_hi: षट्भुज में 6 भुजाएँ होती हैं। अंतःकोणों का योग = (6 − 2) × 180° = 720°। समषट्भुज में सभी कोण समान होते हैं, इसलिए प्रत्येक कोण = 720°/6 = 120°।
questions.trick_en: Interior angle of a regular n-gon = 180° − 360°/n. For n = 6 this is 180° − 60° = 120°.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on elementary geometry for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: The sides of a triangle are 7 cm, 24 cm and 25 cm. What is its area?
questions.text_hi: एक त्रिभुज की भुजाएँ 7 सेमी, 24 सेमी और 25 सेमी हैं। उसका क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.solution_en: Check the Pythagorean relation: 7^2 + 24^2 = 49 + 576 = 625 = 25^2. The triangle is right-angled with legs 7 cm and 24 cm. Area = 1/2 × 7 × 24 = 84 cm².
questions.trick_en: Recognise the 7-24-25 triplet. The area of a right triangle is half the product of its legs, not the hypotenuse.
questions.trick_hi: 7-24-25 त्रिक को पहचानें। समकोण त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल भुजाओं के गुणनफल का आधा होता है, कर्ण का नहीं।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on triangles for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ. Right-angle check recomputed.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: From a point P, 26 cm away from the centre O of a circle of radius 10 cm, a tangent PT is drawn. What is the length of PT?
questions.text_hi: 10 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के केंद्र O से 26 सेमी दूर स्थित बिंदु P से स्पर्श रेखा PT खींची जाती है। PT की लंबाई क्या है?
questions.solution_en: The radius OT is perpendicular to the tangent PT at the point of contact, so triangle OTP is right-angled at T. By Pythagoras, PT^2 = OP^2 − OT^2 = 26^2 − 10^2 = 676 − 100 = 576. Hence PT = 24 cm.
questions.solution_hi: स्पर्श बिंदु पर त्रिज्या OT, स्पर्श रेखा PT के लंबवत होती है, इसलिए त्रिभुज OTP, T पर समकोणीय है। पाइथागोरस से, PT^2 = OP^2 − OT^2 = 26^2 − 10^2 = 676 − 100 = 576। अतः PT = 24 सेमी।
questions.trick_en: Tangent length = √(OP² − r²). Look for the 10-24-26 scaled 5-12-13 triplet.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on circles and tangents for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm is: (Take π = 22/7)
questions.text_hi: 7 सेमी त्रिज्या और 10 सेमी ऊँचाई वाले लंब वृत्तीय बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल क्या है? (π = 22/7 लें)
questions.solution_en: Curved surface area = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 10 = 440 cm². The two circular ends are not part of the curved surface.
questions.solution_hi: वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 10 = 440 सेमी²। दोनों वृत्ताकार सिरे वक्र पृष्ठ में शामिल नहीं हैं।
questions.trick_en: Use CSA = 2πrh, not total surface area 2πr(h + r).
questions.trick_hi: CSA = 2πrh लगाएँ, कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल 2πr(h + r) नहीं।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on mensuration for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: A solid sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into cones of radius 3 cm and height 4 cm. How many such cones can be made?
questions.text_hi: 6 सेमी त्रिज्या वाले एक ठोस गोले को पिघलाकर 3 सेमी त्रिज्या और 4 सेमी ऊँचाई वाले शंकु बनाए जाते हैं। ऐसे कितने शंकु बनाए जा सकते हैं?
questions.solution_en: Volume of sphere = (4/3)π(6)^3 = 288π cm³. Volume of one cone = (1/3)π(3)^2(4) = 12π cm³. Number of cones = 288π / 12π = 24.
questions.trick_en: Equate volumes and cancel π immediately: 288/12 = 24.
questions.trick_hi: आयतन बराबर करें और π तुरंत काटें: 288/12 = 24।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on mensuration for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ. Volume ratio recomputed.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: The value of sin 30° + cos 60° is:
questions.text_hi: sin 30° + cos 60° का मान क्या है?
questions.solution_en: sin 30° = 1/2 and cos 60° = 1/2. Their sum is 1/2 + 1/2 = 1.
questions.trick_en: sin θ = cos(90° − θ); sin 30° = cos 60° = 1/2.
questions.trick_hi: sin θ = cos(90° − θ); sin 30° = cos 60° = 1/2।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on trigonometric ratios for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: If tan θ = 3/4 and θ is acute, then (1 + sin θ)/cos θ equals:
questions.text_hi: यदि tan θ = 3/4 और θ न्यून कोण है, तो (1 + sin θ)/cos θ का मान क्या है?
questions.solution_en: tan θ = 3/4 gives a 3-4-5 triangle, so sin θ = 3/5 and cos θ = 4/5. Then (1 + sin θ)/cos θ = (1 + 3/5)/(4/5) = (8/5)/(4/5) = 2.
questions.trick_en: Convert tan to a right triangle first; avoid inventing θ without fixing the sides.
questions.trick_hi: पहले tan को समकोण त्रिभुज में बदलें; भुजाएँ तय किए बिना θ न मानें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on trigonometric identities for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: From the top of a 60 m high tower, the angles of depression of two cars on the same side of the tower are 45° and 30°. What is the distance between the cars?
questions.text_hi: 60 मीटर ऊँचे टावर के शिखर से, टावर के एक ही ओर स्थित दो कारों के अवनमन कोण 45° और 30° हैं। कारों के बीच की दूरी क्या है?
questions.solution_en: The angle of depression equals the angle of elevation from the car. For the nearer car, 60/d1 = tan 45° = 1, so d1 = 60 m. For the farther car, 60/d2 = tan 30° = 1/√3, so d2 = 60√3 m. Distance between cars = 60√3 − 60 = 60(√3 − 1) m.
questions.solution_hi: अवनमन कोण, कार से उन्नयन कोण के बराबर होता है। निकटवर्ती कार के लिए, 60/d1 = tan 45° = 1, अतः d1 = 60 मी। दूरस्थ कार के लिए, 60/d2 = tan 30° = 1/√3, अतः d2 = 60√3 मी। कारों के बीच दूरी = 60√3 − 60 = 60(√3 − 1) मी।
questions.trick_en: Draw both right triangles from the same height; subtract the two horizontal distances instead of adding them.
questions.trick_hi: एक ही ऊँचाई से दोनों समकोण त्रिभुज बनाएँ; दोनों क्षैतिज दूरियों को जोड़ने के बजाय घटाएँ।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on heights and distances for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: What was the average number of units sold by Store A per year over the four years shown?
questions.text_hi: दिखाए गए चार वर्षों में दुकान A द्वारा प्रति वर्ष बेची गई इकाइयों का औसत क्या था?
questions.solution_en: Store A sold 120 + 150 + 180 + 210 = 660 units over 4 years. Average = 660/4 = 165 units per year.
questions.trick_en: Read only Store A's column; do not average both stores.
questions.trick_hi: केवल दुकान A का स्तंभ पढ़ें; दोनों दुकानों का औसत न निकालें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice DI question for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Synthetic data; not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: Store A's sales in 2024 were what percent more than Store B's sales in 2021?
questions.text_hi: 2024 में दुकान A की बिक्री, 2021 में दुकान B की बिक्री से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक थी?
questions.solution_en: Store A in 2024 = 210 units. Store B in 2021 = 150 units. Percentage more = (210 − 150)/150 × 100 = 60/150 × 100 = 40%.
questions.trick_en: The base is Store B's 2021 sales (150), not Store A's 2024 sales. Use the difference over the base.
questions.trick_hi: आधार 2021 में दुकान B की बिक्री (150) है, दुकान A की 2024 बिक्री नहीं। अंतर को आधार पर विभाजित करें।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice DI question for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Synthetic data; not a PYQ.

questions.subject: Quant
questions.text_en: A family's monthly expenditure of ₹36,000 is shown in a pie chart. If the sector for food subtends 120° at the centre, how much is spent on food?
questions.text_hi: एक परिवार का ₹36,000 का मासिक व्यय पाई चार्ट में दर्शाया गया है। यदि भोजन का क्षेत्र केंद्र पर 120° का कोण बनाता है, तो भोजन पर कितना व्यय होता है?
questions.solution_en: A full pie represents 360°. The food sector is 120°/360° = 1/3 of the total. Food expenditure = 36,000 × 1/3 = ₹12,000.
questions.trick_en: Amount = total × (sector angle/360°). Reduce 120/360 to 1/3 before multiplying.

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on pie charts for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.
